subject: Geopolitics
title: Stuxnet: The Cyber Weapon
description: A short lesson to help you apply Stuxnet: The Cyber Weapon.

hook.text: A computer worm destroyed 1,000 Iranian centrifuges without a bomb, a bullet, or a soldier crossing any border.

buildup.text: Stuxnet was a joint US-Israeli operation launched around 2010. It targeted Iran's nuclear enrichment facilities.

discovery.text: The worm made centrifuges spin out of control while displaying normal readings. Iran's scientists saw nothing wrong.

twist.text: Stuxnet escaped into the wild. Security researchers discovered it and exposed the operation to the world.

climax.text: Stuxnet proved that cyber weapons can achieve what bombs do without the political cost of military strikes.

punchline.text: The most powerful weapon of the century runs on code.

quiz.question: What did the Stuxnet worm physically destroy?
